name: Acushnet
outlook:
What Acushnet says to expect

  • Full year 2026: net salesThe Company is reaffirming its full-year 2026 consolidated net sales guidance range of approximately $2,650 to $2,675 million. On a constant currency basis, consolidated net sales are expected to increase 3.3% to 4.2%.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAThe Company is also narrowing its full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range to approximately $455 to $470 million, from $450 to $470 million previously.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
